testcase.name: Scenario: Toggle sketch line scale editing: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-model-browser-source/features/application/model-browser/model-browser.feature:513:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Toggle sketch line scale editing ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And a nested sketch in the MCAD Software has Default line type ✔ And its geometry properties dialog is open with Scale unchecked ✔ Then the scale value is shown as 1.00 and its field is disabled ✔ When the user checks Scale ✔ Then the scale field is enabled and shows 1.00 ✔ And Apply is enabled ✔ When the user clears Scale ✔ Then the scale field is disabled and still shows 1.00 ✔ When the user clicks Cancel ✔ Then the geometry properties dialog closes
